name: MiniCPM-o-2_6 (omni: vision + audio + speech)
notes: THREE-PART MODEL plus a speech SYNTHESISIZER -- the broadest I/O surface of any record here. (1) Vision: SigLIP vision tower, 27 layers, hidden 1152, 16 heads, patch 14, image_size 980 (top-level image_size 448), with the same LLaVA-STYLE DESIGN AS MiniCPM-V: slice_mode, query_num 64 perceiver resampler, batch_vision_input true, drop_vision_last_layer false. VISION TOKENS: 64 per slice + 1 global, i.e. ~128 for a small image. DOMINANCE: TEXT DOMINATES at default tiling; vision stays bounded by the resampler exactly as in MiniCPM-V. That LLaVA-lineage design is worth stating plainly: MiniCPM did not invent the SigLIP + resampler + tiled-slice scheme, it took it from LLaVA and made it cheap enough for a small model. (2) AUDIO: a Whisper encoder -- audio_config._name_or_path is literally 'openai/whisper-medium', architectures MiniCPMWhisperEncoder, d_model 1024, encoder_layers 24, encoder_attention_heads 16, encoder_ffn_dim 4096 (a Whisper-medium-sized encoder, not large). audio_pool_step 2 halves the audio token rate; audio_chunk_length 1.0. AUDIO TOKENS: a Whisper encoder emits 1,500 frames per 30s chunk; with audio_pool_step 2 that is ~750 audio tokens per 30 seconds. ASYMMETRY WORTH RECORDING: the Whisper DECODER fields are present in the config (decoder_layers 24, forced_decoder_ids, a 70-entry suppress_tokens list, decoder_start_token_id) but MiniCPM-o uses that decoder to produce SPEECH, not text. Audio-to-text goes through the main LLM; audio-to-speech goes through the bundled Whisper decoder. (3) SPEECH OUTPUT: tts_config model_type 'conditional_chattts' with llm_dim 3584, i.e. a ChatTTS conditional generator keyed to the same LLM width. This makes MiniCPM-o bidirectional in audio, which no other record in this slice is. (4) LLM: Qwen2-7B dense decoder, 28 layers, hidden 3584, 28 heads / 4 KV, head_dim 128, intermediate 18944, vocab 151,700, max_position 32,768, rope_theta 1e6, use_sliding_window false (sliding_window 131072 is declared but disabled). ARCHITECTURE = dense. KV CACHE: 28 * 4 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 57,344 B/token. The bundled Whisper-medium decoder is small enough not to move this number. params_b 8.675 = HF API safetensors total (8,674,997,028).
